parameters.query:
DECLARE @dateJoi DATE = '2024-01-01';   -- remplace {$dateJoi}
DECLARE @delai   INT  = 40;             -- délai de traitement en jours
DECLARE @codeDGA VARCHAR(20) = 'S0949'; -- code salarié du DGA

;WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        XSAL.XSAL_0                           AS [Code Salarié],
        XSAL.XMAT_0                           AS [Matricule],
        CAT.LANMES_0                          AS [Catégorie],
        XSAL.XNAMSAL_0 + ' ' + XSAL.XPRENOM_0 AS [Nom Complet],
        XSAL.XDTE_0                           AS [Date d'entrée],
        ZPOSTE.YTIT_0                         AS [Poste],
        ZSERVICES.YTIT_0                      AS [Service],
        XSAL.CREDATTIM_0                      AS [Date de création],
        XSAL.YDATCON_0                        AS [Date de contrôle],

        XSAL.XEMAIL_0                         AS email,
        XSAL.YTELE_0                          AS telephone,
        XSAL.YSUP_0                           AS code_superieur,

        XSAL.CREUSR_0                                        AS user_createur,
        COALESCE(CRE_DIRECT.XSAL_0,    CRE_LOGIN.XSAL_0)     AS code_createur,
        COALESCE(CRE_DIRECT.XNAMSAL_0, CRE_LOGIN.XNAMSAL_0)  AS nom_createur,
        COALESCE(CRE_DIRECT.XPRENOM_0, CRE_LOGIN.XPRENOM_0)  AS prenom_createur,
        COALESCE(CRE_DIRECT.XEMAIL_0,  CRE_LOGIN.XEMAIL_0)   AS email_createur,
        COALESCE(CRE_DIRECT.YTELE_0,   CRE_LOGIN.YTELE_0)    AS tel_createur,

        COALESCE(SUP_DIRECT.XSAL_0,    SUP_LOGIN.XSAL_0)     AS code_sup_createur,
        COALESCE(SUP_DIRECT.XNAMSAL_0, SUP_LOGIN.XNAMSAL_0)  AS nom_sup_createur,
        COALESCE(SUP_DIRECT.XPRENOM_0, SUP_LOGIN.XPRENOM_0)  AS prenom_sup_createur,
        COALESCE(SUP_DIRECT.XEMAIL_0,  SUP_LOGIN.XEMAIL_0)   AS email_sup_createur,
        COALESCE(SUP_DIRECT.YTELE_0,   SUP_LOGIN.YTELE_0)    AS tel_sup_createur,

        dga.XSAL_0       AS code_dga,
        dga.XNAMSAL_0    AS nom_dga,
        dga.XPRENOM_0    AS prenom_dga,
        dga.XEMAIL_0     AS email_dga,
        dga.YTELE_0      AS telephone_dga,

        @delai                                                                   AS delai_int,
        L.date_limite,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(XSAL.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))   AS jours_depuis_creation,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE), CAST(L.date_limite AS DATE))      AS jours_restants,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(XSAL.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE), CAST(L.date_limite AS DATE)) / 2 AS seuil_dga

    FROM [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[XSAL] XSAL

    LEFT JOIN [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[APLSTD] CAT
        ON XSAL.XCAT_0 = CAT.LANNUM_0
        AND CAT.LANCHP_0 = 14003
        AND CAT.LAN_0 = 'FRA'
    LEFT JOIN [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[ZPOSTE]    ZPOSTE    ON XSAL.ZPOSTE_0 = ZPOSTE.YNUM_0
    LEFT JOIN [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[ZSERVICES] ZSERVICES ON ZPOSTE.YSRV_0 = ZSERVICES.YNUM_0

    LEFT JOIN [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[XSAL] CRE_DIRECT
        ON XSAL.CREUSR_0 LIKE 'S%' AND CRE_DIRECT.XSAL_0 = XSAL.CREUSR_0
    LEFT JOIN [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[XSAL] SUP_DIRECT
        ON SUP_DIRECT.XSAL_0 = CRE_DIRECT.YSUP_0

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 YS.XSAL_0
        FROM [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[YSALAUS] YS
        WHERE XSAL.CREUSR_0 NOT LIKE 'S%' AND YS.USER_0 = XSAL.CREUSR_0
    ) YSA
    LEFT JOIN [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[XSAL] CRE_LOGIN ON CRE_LOGIN.XSAL_0 = YSA.XSAL_0
    LEFT JOIN [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[XSAL] SUP_LOGIN ON SUP_LOGIN.XSAL_0 = CRE_LOGIN.YSUP_0

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
                 WHEN XSAL.YDATCON_0 > '1753-01-01' THEN XSAL.YDATCON_0
                 ELSE DATEADD(DAY, @delai, XSAL.CREDATTIM_0)
               END AS date_limite
    ) L

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 XSAL_0, XNAMSAL_0, XPRENOM_0, XEMAIL_0, YTELE_0
        FROM [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[XSAL]
        WHERE XSAL_0 = @codeDGA
    ) dga

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [jbelrh].[JBELRH].[AOBJTXT] AOBJTXT
        WHERE XSAL.XSAL_0 = AOBJTXT.IDENT1_0
          AND AOBJTXT.ABREV_0 = 'XSAL'
    )
    AND CAST(XSAL.CREDATTIM_0 AS DATE) >= @dateJoi
    AND XSAL.XCAT_0 <> 4
)

SELECT b.*, N.niveau_escalade, N.email_destinataire, N.email_cc
FROM base b
CROSS APPLY (
    -- J-4 : le salarié (créateur du dossier)
    SELECT 'SALARIE'  AS niveau_escalade,
           b.email_createur AS email_destinataire,
           CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS email_cc
    WHERE b.jours_restants = 4

    UNION ALL
    -- J-3 ou moins : le supérieur, créateur en copie
    SELECT 'SUPERIEUR', b.email_sup_createur, b.email_createur
    WHERE b.jours_restants <= 3

    UNION ALL
    -- Délai/2 ou moins : le DGA
    SELECT 'DGA', b.email_dga, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255))
    WHERE b.jours_restants <= b.seuil_dga
) N
ORDER BY b.jours_restants, N.niveau_escalade;
